foundation.title: Fundación Líderes de Ansenuza
foundation.intro: FLA is a non-governmental organization based in Miramar de Ansenuza, Córdoba, whose work revolves around the design and execution of educational programs in Argentina.
foundation.paragraph1: The purpose of FLA is to be a support network that helps young people grow into agents of change.
foundation.paragraph2: To achieve that, we offer opportunities, tools, and guidance that strengthen leadership development in their communities.
foundation.paragraph3: Unlike other spaces that focus on theory, FLA promotes learning through concrete action. Participants not only gain knowledge, they apply it in real projects. Their work goes beyond daily tasks: they impact lives and build a better future.
foundation.paragraph4: Our Foundation is made up of volunteers and participants from more than 18 provinces across the country and even reaches people abroad. Our meetings are hybrid: virtual sessions alternate with in-person gatherings. This makes a holistic transformation possible: our young people not only gain knowledge, but also build a 'second FLAmilia' where many find a safe, motivating, and challenging space.

mission.text: Empower young people from across the country to become leaders through educational and motivational programs, providing support and development opportunities so they can carry out social impact projects.

vision.text: A world where new generations have access to quality education, can decide with freedom, and have the motivation to become leaders and positively transform their communities.

leadership.title: LEADERSHIP
leadership.description: We not only cultivate this value in the people we work with, but also in our team and throughout the organization. We believe in leadership that includes, transforms, inspires, and makes things happen.

commitment.title: COMMITMENT
commitment.description: We drive solutions to social problems together with local and emerging leaders, providing personal and professional development tools and giving our best in every project and activity.

empathy.title: EMPATHY
empathy.description: People are at the heart of FLA. We work for and with them, investing time and resources in each person's holistic development, through authenticity, care, and dedication.

freedom.title: FREEDOM
freedom.description: We defend the freedom to choose, think, and be, respecting others and their uniqueness. We are also guided by our principles to decide with autonomy as an organization.

innovation.title: INNOVATION
innovation.description: We reinvent ourselves to stay at the forefront, with disruptive and high-quality educational proposals. We are a collaborative idea engine in constant motion.

intro.body: Welcome to our privacy policy page. At Fundacion Lideres de Ansenuza, we value and respect your privacy. These policies describe how we collect, use, and protect the information you provide to us. We invite you to read them carefully so you can understand how we handle your personal data and how you can exercise your rights. If you have any questions, do not hesitate to contact us.

program.title: Enrollment, participation in programs, and activities

sections.title: What does this privacy policy describe and what legislation is it based on
body: This Personal Data Privacy Policy describes how Fundacion Lideres de Ansenuza, with legal address at Independencia 350, Miramar de Ansenuza, Cordoba, Argentina (hereinafter, "the foundation"), collects, uses, and protects the personal information of people who enroll and participate in its educational programs or in activities directly organized by the foundation.
This Privacy Policy is governed by Personal Data Protection Law No. 25,326, Regulatory Decree No. 1558/2001, and other complementary regulations.

sections.title: What information does the foundation collect and for what purposes
body: The foundation collects the following information: I) Identifying data: first and last name, national ID number, date of birth, gender; II) Contact data: address, postal code, mobile phone, email address; III) Academic information: school attended and grade level; IV) Parent or guardian data (if the participant is a minor): first and last name, mobile phone, and email address.

These data are collected and stored for the purpose of efficiently managing participation in the programs, improving the quality of the services offered, ensuring effective communication, and facilitating the evaluation of the long-term impact of the programs on participants' lives.

sections.title: How does the foundation protect the information collected
body: To guarantee the privacy and security of the information collected, the foundation has several measures in place: it limits access to authorized personnel, implements technological security protocols, and does not share information with third parties without the participant's express consent, except when required by law.

sections.title: What are my rights and how do I exercise them
body: Data subjects have the right to access, correct, and delete their personal information. To do so, they must send an email to contacto@lideresdeansenuza.org, attaching a copy of the front and back of their national ID and the completed and signed form (F-DP02).

If the data subject is a minor, a copy of the front and back of the minor's national ID, a copy of the front and back of the parent's or guardian's national ID, and the completed and signed form (F-DP01) must be attached. Both forms can be found at the end of the policy.

sections.title: How long will the foundation keep the information
body: The foundation will retain your Personal Data for the time necessary to fulfill the purposes described in this Privacy Policy. Your information will be destroyed when it is no longer necessary or relevant for the purposes for which it was collected, unless there is a legal obligation to retain it for a longer period.

sections.title: Is it necessary to accept this privacy policy to enroll in one of the programs
body: By enrolling in one of our programs, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this Privacy Policy. If you are a minor, your parent or guardian must read and accept this document.

sections.title: Final notes
body: The foundation reserves the right to modify this policy at any time, within the limits of applicable law. The changes will take effect after publication.
If you have any questions or concerns, contact contacto@lideresdeansenuza.org.

sections.title: What does this privacy policy describe and what legislation is it based on
body: This Personal Data Privacy Policy describes how Fundacion Lideres de Ansenuza, with legal address at Independencia 350, Miramar de Ansenuza, Cordoba, Argentina (hereinafter, "the foundation"), collects, uses, and protects the personal information of people who subscribe to its newsletter.
This Privacy Policy is governed by Personal Data Protection Law No. 25,326, Regulatory Decree No. 1558/2001, and other complementary regulations.

sections.title: What information does the foundation collect and for what purposes
body: The foundation collects the following information: I) Identifying data: first and last name; II) Contact data: email address. These data are collected and stored for the purpose of sending relevant and up-to-date information about the foundation, including news, events, publications, and related activities. They will also be used to manage newsletter delivery and perform statistical analysis to improve its content and operation.

sections.title: How does the foundation protect the information collected
body: To guarantee the privacy and security of the information collected, the foundation has several measures in place: it limits access to authorized personnel, implements technological security protocols, and does not share information with third parties without the participant's express consent, except when required by law.

sections.title: What are my rights and how do I exercise them
body: Data subjects have the right to access, correct, and delete their personal information. To do so, they may use the links provided in each newsletter email or contact contacto@lideresdeansenuza.org by email.

sections.title: How long will the foundation keep the information
body: The foundation will retain your Personal Data for the time necessary to fulfill the purposes described in this Privacy Policy. Your information will be destroyed when it is no longer necessary or when the data subject unsubscribes from the newsletter.

sections.title: Is it necessary to accept this privacy policy to subscribe to the newsletter
body: By submitting the newsletter subscription form, the user gives express consent to the processing of personal data in accordance with the purposes established in the Privacy Policy. If you are a minor, your parent or guardian must read and accept this document.

sections.title: Final notes
body: The foundation reserves the right to modify this policy at any time, within the limits of applicable law. The changes will take effect after publication.
If you have any questions or concerns, contact contacto@lideresdeansenuza.org.
